Sub:- Compliance Audit of Exempted Establishments — reg. 
Sir, 
Kindly refer to this office circular of even number dt. 15/10/09 vide which it 
was requested that a comprehensive Compliance Audit of all the 
exempted/relaxed establishments (u/s 17(1)/Para-79 or Para — 27A) shall be 
undertaken by all OIC of ROs/SROs during November & December, 2009 
covering the period till 31/03/09. It was also informed in the abovesaid circular 
that a number of cases for grant of exemption are pending in the Head Office for 
want of Compliance Audit Reports and , all the OIC were directed to forward 
copies of Compliance Audit Reports in respect of establishments pending for 
exemption alongwith the specific comments/recommendations of RPFC-1/0IC 
SRO to Head Office. 
It is therefore reiterated to forward the latest Compliance Audit Reports in 
respect of all the establishments pending for grant of exemption alongwith 
RPFC's/OIC's specific comments/ recommendations on or before 15/01/2010 as 
the report is required to be sent to Ministry of Labour. 
Further the Annexure-II of the said circular should also be forwarded to 
Head Office latest by 15/01/2010. The information in Annexure-11 should be 
submitted industrywise (wherever applicable) and sent to Head Office alongwith 
a soft copy in excel format at rpfcexm@rediffmail.com . 
Yo s faithfully,
